pr_title: Fix custom theme outline settings affects the editor theme as well
pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/71006

The `font_outline_color` and `outline_size` settings were never set in the default theme.
Because of this, all `outline` changes affected the editor directly, resulting in a very colorful editor when using it on every control. :P

![godot_theme_bug1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/66004280/212561062-6382c97f-1143-4535-bc0a-ba74ec1cc1da.png)

So this PR sets a default `outline_size` of 0 and a default `font_outline_color`, which for now is transparent since we never use an `outline` in the editor.

Note: While testing I found even more settings which were not set in the default theme and therefore can be overridden for the editor. See the `Buttons` in the screenshot above as an example. I have set the `h_separation` to a much higher value there.

For the sake of simplicity, this PR ONLY touches the two `outline` setting. For the other properties I found, I will submit another PR soon. :)

issue_context.title: Setting a default GUI theme still breaks the editor
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v3.4.4.stable.official [419e713a2]

### System information

Windows 10, GLES3, GeForce GTX 1650

### Issue description

This [issue](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/20123) was fixed according to this [message](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/20123#issuecomment-569793857), but apparently it still persists.

This time however GUI elements appear to be scissored

![Colorpicker](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42402741/167703558-4530410b-f914-47d4-808d-1bf1d0027603.png)
Color picker

![Autocomplete](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42402741/167703711-1b137a40-f435-4241-a240-fef6eddc4b66.png)
Autocomplete (it's there, I can use keyboard to complete, but the list is effectively invisible)

### Steps to reproduce

1. New resource... > Theme
2. Open it in Theme editor
3. Manage Items... > Import Items > Select All > Import Selected
4. Save the theme
5. Project Settings > Gui > Theme > Custom Theme
6. Select the theme, press Save & Restart

### Minimal reproduction project

https://github.com/badunius/godot-theme-bug-repro
comments:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/169297388-5337dcbf-15f2-492c-ba70-aa9a1757268a.png)
The 4.0 issue was addressed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/75566, but this is still relevant, with more problems in 3.x. So in case someone wants to fix these for 3.x, I'm keeping the issue open in the correct milestone.
If you try to make a theme that uses all properties available, some of them will still break the IDE in 4.x, all of them seem to be only affecting margin and separation values inside and outside styleboxes.
